display_long_description:
Your room. Your pistol. A relentless zombie invasion.

Zombie Survival: Mixed Reality brings zombie survival combat into your real surroundings. Face undead emerging from portals and fight to stay alive as enemies become faster and more numerous.

MIXED REALITY ZOMBIE COMBAT
Keep your surroundings in view while taking on approaching zombies. React quickly, choose your targets, and hold your ground as the pressure rises.

HANDS-ON PISTOL RELOADING
Every reload puts your skills to the test. Eject the magazine, insert a fresh one, then pull and release the slide to chamber a round. Keep calm and get back into the fight.

SHOOT, STRIKE, SURVIVE
Land headshots for greater damage or fight at close range with pistol-butt strikes. Use the pistol in either hand and make each shot count.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Casual offers a gentler start without poison attacks. Hardcore brings greater pressure and dangerous poison projectiles. Both modes grow tougher the longer you survive.

BEAT YOUR PERSONAL BEST
Track your recent and highest kill counts separately for each mode. Learn the controls with the How to Play guide, then return for another run and push your record higher.

Step into a mixed reality zombie shooter where steady aim, quick reactions, and confident reloads keep you alive.
